judgment: It is good in the south-west,
but not good in the north-east.
It is good to see the great person.
image: So the noble one turns back to himself
lines: The king's servant limps and limps,
but not for his own sake.
It is good to see the great person.

notes.name_en: 蹇 is lameness, a limping halt; 'Limping', not Wilhelm's 'Obstruction'.
notes.judgment: South-west level, north-east steep — directions kept without the traditional topography glossed in.
notes.L1: 往蹇來譽 and its refrains (L3, L4, L6) kept as verdict tags ('Going: … Coming: …'), as the glossary fixes 往/來； no supplied 'if'.
